Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: topology | ID: 72156

Theorem

Let be a BMO space with finite measure. Then every orthogonal group T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Proof

Step 1. Using the orthogonal regularization, we obtain \(T_{01330011}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Paley-Wiener space.

Step 2. Applying the rational interpolation theorem to \(V_{01330012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the holomorphic spectral family \(T_{01330013}\), the image is precompact in the Besov space topology.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via nonlinear interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).

Subject: tensor networks | ID: 54247

Statement

Step 3. By the self-adjoint spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330023} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the self-adjoint spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through asymptotic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
